items.title: 10.2 Oxidation number aur us ki ahmiyat (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 10.2, printed page 214.

blocks.text: Oxidation numbers ko oxidation states bhi kehte hain. Oxidation number woh number hai jo compound mein har atom ya ion ko diya jata hai aur batata hai ke woh kitna oxidize hua hai (degree of oxidation). Oxidation number positive, negative ya zero ho sakta hai. + ya – ka nishan hamesha likhna zaroori hai. Yeh molecule ya ion mein kisi element ke ek atom par zahiri (apparent) charge hai. Zyada positive oxidation number ka matlab hai ke atom ya ion zyada oxidize hua hai; zyada negative oxidation number ka matlab hai ke woh zyada reduce hua hai.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Oxidation number ek 'hisabi charge' hai: hum farz karte hain ke har bond ke electrons zyada electronegative atom ke paas chale gaye. Misal: H₂O mein oxygen −2 aur har hydrogen +1 hai. Yeh asal charge nahi, sirf hisab ka tareeqa hai.

blocks.prompt: Is ka kya matlab hai ke manganese KMnO₄ mein +7 aur MnCl₂ mein +2 hai?
blocks.explanation: KMnO₄ mein manganese bohat zyada oxidize hua hai (+7). Agar Mn +7 se +2 par aaye to us ka oxidation number 5 kam hota hai, yani har Mn atom 5 electrons leta hai: yeh reduction hai.

items: Oxidation number (oxidation state): ek atom par zahiri charge, nishan (+ ya –) ke saath.
Zyada positive = zyada oxidized; zyada negative = zyada reduced.
